shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'README*' -g 'tsconfig.json' | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la /workspace'
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat .gitignore && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print"
/bin/bash -lc 'find /workspace -name AGENTS.md -print && git status --short && ls node_modules | head -50'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'node --version && npm --version && npm view next version && npm view react version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install next@''^16 react@''^19 react-dom@''^19 && npm install -D typescript @types/node @types/react @types/react-dom'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files app components lib data && cat package.json && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --package-lock-only && npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm audit --omit=dev --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start -- --port 3000'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/commonplace-home.html -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\\n' http://localhost:3000/ && rg -o 'Currently reading|Finished books|Add a book|\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+'"' /tmp/commonplace-home.html | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/commonplace-missing.html -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\\n' http://localhost:3000/books/not-a-book && rg -o 'That book isn.t on the shelf' /tmp/commonplace-missing.html | head -2"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -o '<form["'^>]*>|<input[''^>]*>'"' /tmp/commonplace-home.html | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | rg -o 'Integration Test Book|A. Reader|Notes survive a restart.' | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "cat data/books.json && curl -sS -o /tmp/commonplace-detail.html -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\\n' http://localhost:3000/books/d4ab1174-498f-4167-9ed6-a622bf990bd4 && rg -o 'Integration Test Book|A. Reader|Notes survive a restart.|Copy book link|Mark as finished' /tmp/commonplace-detail.html | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -o '<form["'^>]*>|<input[''^>]*>'"' /tmp/commonplace-detail.html | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start -- --port 3000'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | rg -o 'Integration Test Book|Finished|Currently reading' | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/commonplace-after-restart.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:3000/books/d4ab1174-498f-4167-9ed6-a622bf990bd4 && rg -o 'Notes survive a restart.|Finished|Mark as finished' /tmp/commonplace-after-restart.html | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "npm audit --json > /tmp/commonplace-audit.json || true
node -e 'const a=require(\"/tmp/commonplace-audit.json\"); for (const [name,v] of Object.entries(a.vulnerabilities||{})) console.log(name, v.severity, v.isDirect, v.fixAvailable)'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cp /tmp/commonplace-books-before-test.json data/books.json
npm uninstall vitest'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run typecheck && git status --short && cat data/books.json && cat package.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- .gitignore package.json && cat next-env.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/page.tsx | head -25 && nl -ba app/books/'[id]'/page.tsx | head -30 && nl -ba lib/books.ts | head -35 && nl -ba README.md | head -30"
